method.isolated: Rotating main/current/prior order each repeat, alternating ON/OFF order; fresh process per workload/mode. 28 startup/burst/full/recovery/quiet frames then steady mutation frames. All tails included, no forced GC.
method.original: Original same-process driver, including phase timers and ON-only statistics observer. Separate family, not pooled with isolated. Controls captured earlier in this continuation on exact matched sources.
method.summary: Median of repeat statistics, complete repeat values and ranges. Means are means including natural pauses, not replaced by p50. Scene construction excluded identically; all render/capture work included.
